curator_note: AI-curated independent gold. Topic: LLM for low-resource machine translation. Corpus era: 2020-2025.

topics.topic: Large language models for low-resource machine translation
topics.review_note: Papers covering: few-shot prompting for MT, cross-lingual transfer, low-resource language MT with LLMs.

paper_relevance.title: No Language Left Behind: Scaling Human-Centered Machine Translation (NLLB)
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: NLLB — 200-language MT system achieving SOTA on low-resource languages via massive multilingual training. Directly addresses low-resource MT challenge.

paper_relevance.title: BLOOM: A 176B-Parameter Open-Access Multilingual Language Model
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: BLOOM — open-access multilingual LLM covering 46 languages including low-resource ones. Demonstrates cross-lingual transfer for MT.

paper_relevance.title: Is ChatGPT a Good Translator? Yes With GPT-4 As the Engine
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Systematic evaluation của GPT-4/ChatGPT cho MT — shows few-shot prompting closes gap with supervised MT on high-resource, struggles on low-resource.

paper_relevance.title: Towards Effective Disambiguation for Machine Translation with Large Language Models
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: LLM prompting strategies for MT disambiguation — few-shot prompting improvements for translation quality including in lower-resource settings.

paper_relevance.title: Exploring Human-Like Translation Strategy with Large Language Models
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: MAPS framework — multi-agent prompting strategy for LLM translation inspired by human translation process. Shows prompting can improve low-resource MT.

paper_relevance.title: ParroT: Translating During Chat Using Large Language Models
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Fine-tuning LLM for MT via human feedback — bridges gap between instruction-following LLMs and specialized MT systems for diverse language pairs.

paper_relevance.title: mT5: A Massively Multilingual Pre-trained Text-to-Text Transformer
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: mT5 — massively multilingual T5 covering 101 languages, strong zero-shot cross-lingual transfer for MT. Baseline cho LLM low-resource MT comparison.

paper_relevance.title: ALMA: Advanced Language Model-based trAnslation
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: ALMA — fine-tuned LLaMA for MT using monolingual data first then contrastive preference optimization. State-of-the-art LLM-based MT approach.

paper_relevance.title: LLMs as Low-Resource MT Engines: A Systematic Evaluation
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Systematic evaluation của multiple LLMs cho low-resource MT — directly addresses the topic with benchmark comparison across language pairs.

paper_relevance.title: Survey: LLMs for Low-Resource Machine Translation
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Survey covering LLM approaches for low-resource MT: prompting strategies, fine-tuning, cross-lingual transfer, benchmark evaluation.

paper_relevance.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Machine Translation
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Scaling laws for MT — data and model size requirements for quality MT, especially relevant for low-resource languages where data is scarce.

paper_relevance.title: Tower: An Open Multilingual Large Language Model for Translation-Related Tasks
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Tower — LLM specifically fine-tuned for MT and translation-related tasks. Outperforms GPT-4 on low-resource language pairs with targeted training.

paper_relevance.title: LLM-based Machine Translation: Does Few-Shot Prompting Help Low-Resource Languages?
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Ablation study of few-shot prompting strategies for low-resource MT with LLMs — shows which techniques help most when parallel data is scarce.

paper_relevance.title: COMET: A Neural Framework for MT Evaluation
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: COMET — neural MT evaluation metric correlating with human judgment. Standard for evaluating LLM-based MT quality on low-resource language pairs.

paper_relevance.title: In-Context Learning for Few-Shot Machine Translation in the Age of LLMs
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Systematic study of few-shot in-context learning for MT with GPT-style models — analyzes example selection strategies for low-resource language pairs.

topics.reference_answer: Large language models have transformed machine translation, including for low-resource languages. Three key themes: (1) Few-shot prompting: GPT-4 achieves competitive MT quality via zero/few-shot prompting on high-resource pairs but degrades on low-resource (Jiao et al. 2023); advanced prompting strategies (MAPS, ALMA) improve quality. (2) Cross-lingual transfer: BLOOM (176B parameters, 46 languages) and mT5 enable zero-shot MT via pre-training on multilingual corpora; transfer from related high-resource languages is most effective. (3) Low-resource languages: NLLB (Meta 2022) supports 200 languages with dedicated low-resource data collection; fine-tuning LLMs on monolingual data before bilingual data (ALMA) outperforms direct fine-tuning. Persistent challenges: extreme low-resource settings (<10K parallel sentences), morphologically complex languages, domain-specific terminology.
